# canary

> Error and uptime monitoring on OpenTelemetry, with burn-rate alerts and proof the page gets delivered.

canary is an agent-native, recursively self-improving agent employee: a coding agent's senior SRE for
errors, uptime, latency, release health, SLO burn-rate alerting, structured logs and on-call with
restraint. It instruments once on OpenTelemetry and refuses the footguns that silently corrupt every
downstream signal. Powered by Energy.

**The one boundary (read this first).** App health only; LLM token spend is agentmoney's. canary reads
`gen_ai.client.operation.duration` / `.exception` / `error.type` off a GenAI span and stops at
`gen_ai.usage.*`. canary and agentmoney read disjoint attribute sets off the same OpenTelemetry GenAI
span (shared tag `gen_ai.request.model`). canary never holds a cost or token metric
(`brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md` JOB 0).

**The default stack** (locked, `brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md`): OpenTelemetry (instrument-once substrate) ·
Sentry (errors, traces, release health, Seer) · Prometheus + Grafana (metrics, SLO / MWMBR burn-rate) ·
Checkly (synthetic and uptime, monitoring as code) · pino (structured logs) · PagerDuty / incident.io
(on-call) · BetterStack (uptime alt). Defaults are wired; alts are documented, not wired.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): how an agent consumes canary (CLI commands, MCP tools, when to call which, what it refuses). The one source of instructions.
- [identity/SOUL.md](./identity/SOUL.md): who canary is: the creed ("page on symptoms, delete alerts, test delivery, causality over volume"), what it is, does and refuses.
- [README.md](./README.md): what it is, the quick start, and the one-step install for every coding agent.
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): Claude Code operating rules (imports AGENTS.md).
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the stances a consuming agent should adopt (page on symptoms not causes, the senior move is to delete an alert, test the delivery path, never average a percentile, never alert on a rate without a volume floor).

## Skills

- [instrument-with-otel](./skills/instrument-with-otel/SKILL.md): instrument a service once in OpenTelemetry so errors, latency and uptime come from one stream.
- [slo-burn-rate-alerting](./skills/slo-burn-rate-alerting/SKILL.md): an SLO with multi-window, multi-burn-rate alerting that decides page, ticket or freeze.
- [test-alert-delivery](./skills/test-alert-delivery/SKILL.md): prove a page can be delivered on every channel, and fail loudly when one is dead (the differentiator).
- [fix-source-maps](./skills/fix-source-maps/SKILL.md): make minified production stack traces symbolicate with Debug-ID source-map upload in CI.
- [tame-cardinality-and-percentiles](./skills/tame-cardinality-and-percentiles/SKILL.md): fix unbounded metric labels and averaged percentiles.

## MCP tools

canary's own MCP server ([src/mcp/server.ts](./src/mcp/server.ts), bin `canary-mcp`). Start it with
`npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/canary canary-mcp`. It is distinct from the consumed query servers
(`sentry`, `grafana`, `prometheus`) in `.mcp.dev.json`, which use environment references only.

- [instrument_service](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): wire OpenTelemetry into a target service.
- [scaffold_slo](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): write a promtool-valid MWMBR SLO ruleset.
- [audit_observability](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): detect the version-specific footguns, keyed by section ID.
- [check_delivery](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): fire a synthetic page through each channel and confirm receipt.
- [release_health](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): planned (needs Sentry credentials); returns a planned status today.
- [detect_cardinality](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): flag unbounded metric labels and emit the Collector strip config.
- [explain_pitfall](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): print one scenario, pitfall or opinion by ID.
- [search_brain](./src/mcp/tools/index.ts): BM25 search over the six brain files.

## CLI

- [canary](./src/cli/index.ts): `instrument` · `slo` · `audit` · `check-delivery` · `cardinality` · `brain` · `explain` · `eval`. Planned stubs, advertised in `--help`: `release-health` · `uptime`. Run `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/canary canary --help`; exit 0 on success, non-zero on error; `--json` on every data command.

## Sub-agents

- [observability-auditor](./.claude/agents/observability-auditor.md): audits instrumentation config footguns: source-map Debug IDs §1, `tracesSampleRate` §1b.3, the ad-blocker `tunnel` §1b.2, the v9 `autoSessionTracking` trap §3.1, unbounded cardinality §5, averaged percentiles §6.
- [alerting-reviewer](./.claude/agents/alerting-reviewer.md): audits the alert and on-call surface: rate without a floor §2.1, MWMBR correctness S6, `send_resolved` §8.2, `dedup_key` §8.5, dead tools §10.3, the delivery-path gap S5.

## Brain (the expertise, cite these)

- [brain/MOC - canary.md](./brain/MOC%20-%20canary.md): the brain index, the hub for all six artifacts.
- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](./brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the 10 JOBS; start here; JOB 0 is the agentmoney boundary.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](./brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): S1 to S18 real failure and migration cases (symptom, diagnosis, resolution, verify); each is a golden eval with a binary verify.
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](./brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): §1 to §12 version-specific footguns, each with detection and avoidance.
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](./brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): per-tool default against alt, the agent-access surface (MCP, CLI, REST), required secrets.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](./brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): live disputes (both sides) and what is unconfirmed (say "re-verify").

The ID index: **S-IDs** (`S1`…`S18`, `brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md`): `canary explain S5` is the page
that never delivered. **§-IDs** (`§1`…`§12`, `brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md`): `canary explain §1b.3` is
`tracesSampleRate:1.0` in prod. **A-/B-/C-/D-IDs** (`A1`…`D5`, `brain/OPINIONS.md`): `canary explain A5`
is never alert on a rate without a volume floor. Query the brain: `canary brain "page never delivered"`
returns `BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md S5` and `OPINIONS.md A4`.
